out_items.name: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated

violations.title: Safe, Unadulterated & Honestly Presented
violations.observation: The following food item(s) is observed to be unsound or adulterated: OBSERVED SEVERAL RUSTED CANS STORED ON A PREP TABLE SHELF IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food shall be safe, unadulterated and honestly presented as specified under 3-601.12. CDI: PIC DISCARDED THE CANS. EHS RE-EDUCATED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED RAW HAMBURGER PATTIES AT 46 F IN THE TWO DOOR REACH IN COOLER LOCATED IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: THE HAMBURGER PATTIES WERE VOLUNTARILY DISCARDED.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: OBSERVED NO ASTERISK AND FULL DISCLOSURE FOR THE CHEESEBURGER, HAMBURGER, AND STEAK.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. CDI: PIC ADDED ASTERISKS TO THE MADE TO ORDER FOOD ITEMS AND THE FULL CONSUMER ADVISORY DISCLOSURE TO THE MENU DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at Rear bar handwashing sink
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC replaced soap

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at rear bar handwashing sink
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing.PIC replaced paper towels
